skills.name: Petunia
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle as long as this unit is alive. Affects self and both adjacent allies. Restores HP equal to 1% of the skill user's final max HP every second. Incoming Healing ▲ 2.36% continuously. Stacks up to 5 times. ■ Activates after performing 100 normal attacks. Affects all Electric Code allies. Increases the stack count of stackable buffs by 1.

skills.name: Iris
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when the HP of an adjacent ally drops to 90% or below while the ally is still alive. Affects all allies. Creates a shield with HP equal to 6.04% of the skill user's final max HP that lasts for 10 sec. ■ Activates when either adjacent ally reaches max HP. Affects all allies. True Damage ▲ 18.3% for 5 sec.

skills.name: Secret Garden
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects all allies. Restores HP equal to 6.17% of the skill user's final max HP. True Damage ▲ 25.05% for 10 sec.
